newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London slightly up, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London slightly up, trade thin.

text.p: Hong Kong shares were steady to marginally higher on Monday but trading activity was light as investors remained cautious about Wall Street's near-term direction.
"We've seen one or two trades today but nothing to speak of. It's pretty quiet," one dealer said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 19.34 points to 12,629.51 by 1350 GMT. In Hong Kong on Monday, the Hang Seng Index slipped 35.59 points to 12,610.17. (c) Reuters Limited 1997
